caption: A young woman with dark hair and strong eyebrows holds a clear drinking glass partly filled with water, a teal straw slanting through it and appearing visually bent at the waterline. She faces the camera against a plain yellow wall, her mouth shifting continuously as she talks. One hand supports the glass from below while a second hand enters from the left. The extended index finger of this hand moves steadily rightward, approaching the glass wall. Over time the fingertip is positioned level with the waterline on the left side of the glass. The glass, the water surface and the straw stay essentially fixed relative to her face throughout. The composition and yellow background remain constant, with no clear camera movement.
